decisions.e2e: random-init CNN trained jointly with FQL

disk_note: plan GPU/RAM preserved; added output-growth allowances

dynamo.reason: no camera pose, depth or track enters inputs or targets

e2e_cnn.reason: pixels, the robot's own kinematics and the sent commands only
e2e_cnn.uses: single-view RGB history + proprioception + recorded commands

fql_reviwo.reason: no camera pose, depth or track enters inputs or targets

fql_sincro.reason: the rendering targets are cast along rays from the extrinsics (sincro_forward_per_sample_cameras); its encoder is therefore trained on calibration-dependent targets
fql_sincro.uses: RGB windows + per-sample K / c2w rays for its rendering loss

mvp3d.reason: the fused point cloud and its bounds are built with the extrinsics
mvp3d.uses: RGB-D back-projected into the robot base frame, base-frame scene bounds

mvp3d_single.reason: the fused point cloud and its bounds are built with the extrinsics
mvp3d_single.uses: RGB-D back-projected into the robot base frame, base-frame scene bounds

ours.reason: tracks are lifted to the base frame and depth is fused with the camera-to-robot extrinsics (pretraining deferred until the architecture is final)
ours.uses: dynamic 3D tracks in the robot base frame, depth fused across cameras, camera poses

reviwo.reason: no camera pose, depth or track enters inputs or targets

sincro.reason: the rendering targets are cast along rays from the extrinsics (sincro_forward_per_sample_cameras); its encoder is therefore trained on calibration-dependent targets
sincro.uses: RGB windows + per-sample K / c2w rays for its rendering loss

snerl.reason: the encoder input poses and every rendered ray come from the extrinsics; a wrong calibration changes inputs and targets
snerl.uses: 3 RGB views + normalised camera poses (encoder input); RGB / semantic / DINO targets rendered along rays
